About Hank's Tool Rental
A Family Business Since 1987

Hank (left) and his son Marcus at the rental counter, summer 2019.


Our Story
    I started Hank's Tool Rental in March of 1987 out of a two-bay garage on Perkins Avenue. I'd been working as a foreman over at the steel mill for twelve years and I was tired of working for somebody else. My dad always said if you can fix anything with your hands you'll never starve, and renting tools seemed like a way to keep my hands busy and let other folks keep theirs busy too.

    In the beginning we had maybe 30 items total — a couple of mowers, a tile cutter, a few ladders, some hand tools. My wife Linda kept the books on a yellow legal pad. Word got around and by 1992 we needed a bigger building, so we moved to the current location on Industrial Way. Took out a loan that scared me half to death. Paid it off in 2001.

    Today we've got over 200 rental items, a fleet of three delivery trucks, two equipment trailers, and a crew that knows what they're doing. My son Marcus came on full-time in 2008 after he got out of the Navy. My nephew Dale handles deliveries and most of the equipment maintenance — he's also the one who built this website back in 2007 (don't blame him, it was a Sunday afternoon project).

Meet The Crew

Hank Pemberton
Owner, Founder 		That's me. I'm the one who'll usually answer the phone if you call in the morning. Started the shop in 1987, been here ever since. Born and raised in Sandusky — Perkins High School class of 1972. If you've got a tricky job and you don't know what equipment you need, ask me. Forty years in this business and I've seen just about everything.

Marcus Pemberton
General Manager 		My son Marcus came home from the Navy in 2008 and started running the counter. These days he handles most of the day-to-day — scheduling, ordering, training the part-timers. If you're picking up something heavy he's the one who'll show you how to load it in your truck so it doesn't slide around. He also fixes most of the chainsaws.

Dale Pemberton
Delivery & Equipment 		Dale is my nephew (my brother Earl's boy). He runs the delivery trucks and keeps all the big equipment running — trenchers, compactors, generators, the whole bit. If you ordered party tent setup, Dale's the one who'll show up at your house. He's also the unofficial webmaster, which is to say he made this website twenty years ago and we keep telling him he should redo it.

The Rest of the Crew
Part-Time Staff 		We've got four part-timers who help out on weekends and during the busy spring and summer months: Joe, Ryan, Carla, and "Big Pete". Most of them have worked here for years. If you've ever rented from us on a Saturday morning, you've probably met Big Pete — he's the one in the Cleveland Browns hat.


What Makes Us Different
    Look, there are bigger rental places — the chains, the home improvement stores. They've got nicer websites and slicker advertising. Here's what we have that they don't:

✔ A real person on the phone. Call us and you'll talk to me, Marcus, or Dale. Not a phone tree. Not a call center in another state.
✔ We'll show you how to use it. If you've never run a tile saw or a stump grinder, we'll walk you through it in the parking lot before you leave. No charge.
✔ Fair, posted prices. Same price for everybody. No "contractor discount" haggling, no surprise fees. The price on this website is the price.
✔ Well-maintained equipment. Dale services every machine after every rental. If it's not right, we won't rent it. If something breaks during your rental, we'll swap it out at no charge.
✔ We deliver. For an additional fee we'll bring it to your job site or your backyard. Particularly handy for tents, scaffolding, and big equipment.
✔ We're locally owned. Your rental dollar stays in Erie County. We sponsor the Sandusky Little League and the Volunteer Fire Department's annual pancake breakfast.


Community Involvement
    Hank's Tool Rental has been a proud sponsor of Sandusky Little League (the Hank's Tigers!) since 1994. We also donate tent and table use every year to the Erie County Volunteer Fire Department for their pancake breakfast fundraiser, and we provide discounted rentals to Habitat for Humanity volunteer build days.

    If you're running a non-profit fundraiser or a community event in Erie County and you need equipment, give us a call. We try to help out when we can.
